dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible in the mid-dorsal region. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A moderate density of small, asymmetrical solid light-intensity clusters is present, primarily localized between the larger annuli and along the dorsal ridge where internal gradients are absent.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent circular annuli in the mid-section form a scalene triangle, with the longest side oriented roughly parallel to the longitudinal axis of the animal's body.
